# Indra’s jewel net

<a id="indra-selected-telling"></a>
## #0 — A jewel is chosen within the net

The net belongs to Indra’s celestial image-world. Its development here belongs to Chinese Huayan: the contemplation transmitted in the *Huayan wujiao zhiguan*, conventionally attributed to Dushun, whose authorship remains disputed. Thomas Cleary’s English excerpt in *Dharma Rain* (2000), pages 58–60, is the selected translation; its earlier container is *Entry into the Inconceivable* (1983), pages 66–68. These are distinct temporal addresses. Neither translation date dates the narrated heaven, and Indra’s Indian setting does not relocate the Chinese doctrinal work. The [Dushun-attributed source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dushun/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra.md) **sources** this transmission and preserves its attribution and edition limits.

The telling begins with knowledge. If phenomena arise through conditions, how can they be known? The answer places knowing within their relation. The contemplating eye encounters a field in which phenomena enter one another; it cannot secure an independent beginning outside that field and then look down upon the result. The jewel net gives this encounter a visible body.

The jewels are clear. In every jewel the others appear, and what appears includes their reflections of one another. Choose a jewel in the southwest. The choice gives attention an exact place to begin. All the other jewels are reflected there together. Each of those jewels also reflects the whole, including the selected jewel. Following a reflection therefore brings the point of departure back into view within the very field it discloses. The net opens again inside its own appearance.

Nothing in the operation reserves this capacity for the southwest jewel. Begin elsewhere and the same relation holds. Every jewel supplies a particular entrance; none has to travel to a privileged centre before the others can become present. The text makes the claim through simultaneous manifestation and the absence of coming and going. The ordered sentences teach attention how to follow what the image presents together. Their sequence must not be converted into a physical account of signals taking successive journeys.

<a id="indra-recursive-entry"></a>
## #1 — Entering the others without leaving this one

Now the contemplation asks the reader to remain within the selected jewel. To enter all the jewels from here is to discover their presence in this one; in those jewels this one is present again. The movement reverses without losing its starting place. Reflections contain reflections which contain the first reflection, with no final image at which the relation becomes exhausted.

An interlocutor presses the difficulty. How can one enter all while remaining here? The reply makes remaining here the condition of entry. Leaving the jewel behind would abandon the very relation through which the others are disclosed. Another question follows: if the many are present within this one, why speak of a net made from many jewels at all? The answer treats the one in its comprehensive aspect. Its formation includes the many; remove that constitutive participation and this whole net has not been preserved. The movement repeatedly brings the apparent opposition between one jewel and many jewels back to how each is present through the others.

The final test gives the contemplation a mark. Put an ink dot upon the southwest jewel. The dot appears throughout the reflected field. Its many appearances do not require someone to have gone around physically marking every jewel. Begin with another jewel and the relation can be followed from there as well. The mark makes a return inspectable: something done at this definite place becomes present through the others, and the others disclose this place in turn.

Indra supplies the celestial name; the jewels, their clarity, their reflected images, the selected direction, the ink mark, the questioner and the answering contemplative voice each have work to do. This is the whole action of a teaching image. It needs no invented battle, weaving episode or feast to become a narrative. Its development occurs as each question changes what the initial sight of a shining net can mean.

The expanded sequence is recoverable in the Chinese text, T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16. The [CBETA primary-text transcription](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cbeta-org/xml-p5/master/T/T45/T45n1867.xml) **sources** the selected jewel, reciprocal entry, questions, ink-dot test and closing qualification. The account here is a prose paraphrase, not a newly certified quotation from Cleary’s selected printed edition.

<a id="indra-simile-and-distinctness"></a>
## #2 — The image teaches where its own likeness ends

The teaching does not end with the ink dot. It turns upon its simile. Jewels have images which enter one another while their material substances remain separate; the phenomena for which the image is being used interpenetrate more completely. The resemblance is therefore partial. This restriction belongs to the source’s own movement, immediately after its most forceful demonstration. It prevents the observer from taking the optical apparatus as a complete account of the reality contemplated.

The closing verses direct the teaching toward Vairocana’s activity for beings. Formless reality manifests forms; the immeasurable is present through particular appearances. The contemplative return has a purpose beyond admiration of an ingenious arrangement. The image is offered to open understanding, and its own inadequacy becomes part of that offering. Its jewel substances do not establish an ontology of permanently isolated things. Equally, the source’s stronger claim about interpenetration needs to be understood within Huayan, rather than translated without remainder into another tradition’s account of identity.

The [Van Norden–Jones source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/van-norden/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep.md) **qualifies** the reading through two separate passages. Its §1.3 account concerns dependence for existence and identity. Its §3 account of Zhiyan’s Ten Mysteries preserves distinction within mutual inclusion and determination. These are different explanatory contributions in a specialist secondary source; they do not certify Dushun’s authorship or supply the missing English page collation. Their [fixed Fall 2024 text](https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/fall2024/entries/buddhism-huayan/) keeps those doctrinal passages available.

Together they let the image retain its positive force. Each jewel is definite enough to be selected, reflected and marked. Its definiteness participates in the field which appears through it. The inward depth of the reflection and the outward plurality of the net are both active. [C24, Fusion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C24-Fusion.md) **qualifies** the authorial comparison at this precise point: an account of inclusion fails its task when it erases the differences through which relation can occur. This is the essay’s criterion for a crossing between registers, not a substitution of C24 for Huayan’s own account of interpenetration.

The [Homologia / Analogia whole field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing through all three of its offices. Homological agreement asks what operation is preserved: a definite local member discloses its constitutive relations, including their return through that member. Analogical proportion identifies the respect in which an image can carry that operation while its objects remain different. The research boundary prevents recursion from proving common doctrine, historical descent or a common physical cause. These are register-3 operations. The source’s own qualification now **returns-to** that field with a further question: can the comparison state where its chosen material ceases to carry the relation? A12 and A13 receive a more exact comparative instrument; the Huayan passage retains authority to correct its use.

<a id="indra-native-relation"></a>
## #3 — The definite jewel carries its constituting field

The essay’s [native core](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the QL relation before its refraction through this image. The [Definition of God, Draft 3 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) **sources** the author’s relation, formal-limit and ethical return; this internal manuscript supplies authorial provenance, while the Huayan houses supply the external telling. [A11](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **define** the two offices: `0 = One`, Self-Identity; `1 = All`, Self-Difference. One is not another jewel standing outside the net. All is not simply the number obtained by inventorying its members. The [Two Ones Matheme](../../../../matheme/ql/two-ones.md) **derives** the native distinction and keeps its numerical comparisons exact. The chosen jewel figures a determination through which an already active relation becomes locally available.

[A12, Mono/Poly](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** the whole-first consequence. Under its inclusive aspect the whole contains real particulars; under its generative aspect it is their constituting relation. [The Mono Matheme](../../../../matheme/mono-poly/mono.md) **defines** how `0/1` and `1/0` preserve expression and return in different orientations. The jewel’s presence within others’ reflections gives that return an image. Calling the jewel locally whole must preserve its dependence in the respect through which it is a local member.

The programme’s braid has three distinguishable tasks. [A08](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md), with [C18, Apoha](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C18-Apoha.md), **qualifies** determination through constitutive exclusion: the positive reference retains its relation to non-application. Nominally and verbally bound negation do different work; their pairing cannot simply cancel into an isolated positive. Dependent arising names conditioned occurrence. The essay then brings these into relation with saṃkalpa’s world-building office. The Huayan net supplies recursive mutual inclusion to this authored braid; it does not itself teach all three as one doctrine.

[A05](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13, Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **qualify** the reflective crossing further. Śaiva luminous appearing and reflexive articulation are inseparable powers. An inert reflected picture does not perform the self-apprehension, retention and free formation that their source field articulates. The jewel therefore cannot establish consciousness by being reflective. The achieved comparison returns to A05 with this exact question: which relation is being disclosed, and which activity is actually performed? The distinct source traditions survive that question intact.

[A18](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** the complete native sequence `−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`, under the parent `/ = −/−`. This image lets its movement be followed without manufacturing eight ancient jewels. A determination emerges within relation; the selected point becomes question and response; its contrast remains held; the indefinite particular `x` participates without exhausting `X`. Address carries the relation into an encounter, and the local differential remains exact within inexhaustible articulation. The return reopens the source relation through the achieved appearance. `X/x`, `AM/IS` and `∞/dx` retain their authorial offices; neither a reflective stone nor the net’s recurrence proves a human subject, calculus or the native derivation. The reader’s traversed relation to the image is the mythemic work.

The page’s six positions follow selection, recursive entry, qualification, authored determination, answerable use and return. Their number does not replace the eight determinations. Native `2+2²=6` retains two terms and their four ordered pairings; it is not a count discovered in the treatise. [A13](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md), [C50](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) and the [Dia/Syn Matheme](../../../../matheme/dia-syn/README.md) **qualify** the local cut and gathering: choosing a jewel makes attention determinate while keeping the field it distinguishes active. Polar relation, additive cancellation and directed appropriation remain different operations. Simultaneous reflection and the reader’s passage through the teaching likewise retain distinct temporal offices.

<a id="indra-account-and-consequence"></a>
## #4 — A reflection becomes answerable for its use

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **extends** the return through its three terms and four operations at evidence register 3. **Symbol answers to source:** this net conducts a source-specific relation, including the passage’s qualification of its own simile. [A20, Image / Valuation / Possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) receives the consequence that an impressive image must remain alterable by what it represents. Popularity or beauty cannot discharge that relation.

**Account does not replace source:** a description of what is reflected in one jewel is an articulation within the field. [C38, Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **qualifies** the technical consequence. A locally agreed reference can function as Bimba for a judgment while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. Its local authority is real; it is answerable beyond that office. [A26, Objective Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) receives the distinction between conditions of worldhood and a representation within them. The net helps disclose the difference without turning Huayan into a database architecture.

**Trust keeps the return route active:** using an account involves committed reliance upon a relation it cannot exhaust. [A23](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the difference between making dependence inspectable and undertaking its continuation. The jewel’s clarity supplies no promise that another person will answer, no guarantee against harm and no substitute for an actual commitment. [A27](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **qualifies** belonging: the Other can be within Mono while exceeding my possession. A human participant’s refusal remains consequential even within a shared field.

**Account re-enters source-field:** after an image guides action, its consequences become conditions of the next account. The ink-dot episode is a precise source image of a local mark appearing throughout reflection. The essay’s further operation concerns conduct which changes the conditions under which future descriptions act. These are distinguishable kinds of return. [A30](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) and [C42](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extend** the latter through plural local worlds: sources, permissions, gauges and circulation rules can be affected at different sites. A reflected mark is not evidence that such institutional revisions occurred.

All four operations **returns-to** the Symbol / Account / Trust field together. The whole image gives the Symbol something definite to disclose; its textual limit corrects the Account; reliance carries that account into use; the effects of use return a changed question to the image and its sources. The new participant generated by this encounter is an answerable comparison, not a new lexical ancestor or an additional primitive called Return.

Only after this positive whole has unfolded does it **compare** with [the distinct Ares–Aphrodite–Hephaestus–Poseidon whole](../../hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release). The declared double-net reading distinguishes mutual implication from capture organised as public evidence. Homer’s bonds and release keep their actors and sequence; this contemplative net keeps its jewels and recursive entry. Their relation is the essay’s Offered comparison. Neither net supplies a missing episode or a historical origin for the other.

<a id="indra-whole-return"></a>
## #5→0 — Return to the jewel whose brightness depends on the others

The technical and ethical return asks what a local office does with the conditions it receives. [A29, Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **tests** whether the receipt of a product also admits the labour, costs and consequences borne elsewhere. [C54, Commons / Non-Monopoly](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) **defines** the practical powers at stake: set terms, refuse, revise, leave and reconnect. The jewel-net comparison supplies no ready-made governance. It gives the authored question a whole image: how does a definite participant sustain the relation through which its own capacity is possible?

[C62, Planetary Computation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C62-Planetary-Computation.md) **extends** that question through material and institutional conditions. Energy, labour, infrastructure and authority require actual inquiry; shining jewels cannot stand in for their measurement. [A35, Compassion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **grounds** the loving sensitivity which keeps origins consequential. The return reaches the terms of a commission when those sustaining it bear consequences it has excluded. This is the essay’s vocation and applied demand, with source-specific empirical work still required.

The three programme movements receive different yields. This whole **returns-to** [M10, Apoha](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/10-s0-p3-apoha.md), with the selected member’s constitutive field and the distinction between semantic exclusion and Huayan mutual inclusion. It **returns-to** [M22, the two-net encounter](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia.md), with a positive recursive whole sufficiently developed to enter a comparison with the separately told capture and release. It **returns-to** [M46, Sovereign Commons](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly.md), with locally authoritative centres whose shared consequence does not erase their power to contest a reference field. That architecture retains its Offered standing.

The achieved image **returns-to** [A36, Integral Zero](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), as a Symbol capable of another traversal. The shared [Neumann archetypal ground](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond) **qualifies** the essay’s articulation of relation, differentiation and return; it does not replace this Chinese telling, date its transmission or establish its doctrinal ancestry. The local world remains legible within the shared field.

Return now to the southwest jewel. The mark remains particular. Its reflection among the others makes the starting point present again, while the source’s final qualification prevents the viewer from possessing the teaching through a completed optical picture. What has changed is the encounter: the chosen jewel can no longer be understood apart from the relations its brightness makes visible. The return leaves a definite place from which to look again.

**Amplification standing.** `human-amplified: yes` applies to the declared recursive-whole/retained-distinctness relation, the authored apoha–dependent-arising–saṃkalpa braid, the native Mono/Poly and Dia/Syn crossing, the double-net comparison, and their declared A/C/E/M returns. It does not turn this agent’s prose into authorial quotation. `human-amplified: no` applies to the newly developed application of the source’s self-limiting simile to the Etymology field’s comparison test. No additional ancient narrative, empirical network result or independently ratified symbolic edge is asserted.

**Source boundary.** Cleary’s selected 2000 printed wording remains uncollated. The Chinese continuation through the dot test, simile qualification and closing verses is now housed in the [source’s complete contemplative continuation](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dushun/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra.md#huayan-complete-contemplation), with the primary XML and its exact span retained. Van Norden–Jones q001 retains quotation-ready standing and q002 source-matched paraphrase standing. Neither status certifies the native derivation or the proposed institutional application.
